# sonarqube_secured_setting (Resource)

A secured setting (key ending in `.secured`). SonarQube never returns its value, so only its presence is checked for drift. Import ID: `key` or `key:component`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# value_wo keeps the secret out of state (Terraform 1.11+). Bump
# value_wo_version to apply a new value.
resource "sonarqube_secured_setting" "github_auth_secret" {
  key              = "sonar.auth.github.clientSecret.secured"
  value_wo         = var.github_oauth_client_secret
  value_wo_version = "1"
}

variable "github_oauth_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Setting key.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `component` (String) Project, application or portfolio key. Omit for a global setting.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Value. Stored in state; prefer `value_wo`.
- `value_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only value, never stored in state (Terraform 1.11+). Change `value_wo_version` to apply a new one.
- `value_wo_version` (String) Any value; changing it applies the current `value_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_secured_setting.example 'sonar.auth.github.clientSecret.secured'
```
